digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler Jira Data Center integration
propositions: A bidirectional reconciliation pass over a real store copy with isolated remotes must prove data moves in both directions without corruption or unintended external writes
The copied store must be structurally scrubbed of production Jira bindings and reconciler artifacts to prevent phantom deletes and re-creates
Comprehensive single-cell mutations in both directions must round-trip against per-mutation oracles, with idempotence asserted separately after each direction
Pagination must be exercised with explicit page-size discovery and seeding beyond the cap to prevent silent truncation
Every mutation failure must be attributed to a specific product defect or platform limitation, never to a vacuous or self-referential test oracle
